summary.text: Destiny Clayton, the Green Party candidate for the U.S. House in Michigan's 9th District, lost the November 3, 2026 election to Lisa McClain.
Clayton received 0.3% of the vote to Lisa McClain's 62.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
Clayton advanced from the party's April 25, 2026 convention; little biographical information is available in public sources.

sources.title: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2026
